nodes.label: AUTOSCIENTISTS System

nodes.label: AutoScientists: Self-Organizing Agent Teams for Scientific Experimentation

nodes.label: AUTOSCIENTISTS: Multi-Agent System for Automated Scientific Research
nodes.rationale: Core system for autonomous multi-agent scientific discovery combining experiment agents, analyst agents, and self-organized team formation

nodes.label: Experiment Agent
nodes.rationale: Executes experiments by claiming queued tasks, applying code diffs, training candidates, and gating promotions against noise floor

nodes.label: Analyst Agent
nodes.rationale: Maintains team knowledge by auditing untested parameters, ranking research directions by empirical effect size, and queueing proposals

nodes.label: Self-Organized Team Formation
nodes.rationale: Agents write roster R through structured discussion; triggered at cold-start bootstrap and mid-run when stagnation detected

nodes.label: Heartbeat Protocol
nodes.rationale: Per-invocation dispatch mechanism routing agents to discussion branch, no-team exit, resume branch, or role-specific normal cycle

nodes.label: Shared State S
nodes.rationale: Persistent coordination surface containing task spec, experiment log, champion p*, team queues Qk, dead-end registry, and forum F

nodes.label: Noise-Aware Champion Validation Gate
nodes.rationale: Prevents champion pollution by gating promotions against empirically measured noise floor σ; accepts clear improvements, confirms marginal ones with second seed, rejects non-improvements

nodes.label: Queue and Claim Protocol
nodes.rationale: Optimistic locking on version token ensures atomic queue updates and prevents duplicate experiment claims

nodes.label: Analyst Proposal Protocol
nodes.rationale: Generates two proposals per invocation via baseline coverage audit, empirical axis priors, ambition quota, diversity constraints, and post-KEEP follow-up

nodes.label: File Discovery Protocol
nodes.rationale: List-decide-read pattern allows agents to discover new artifact types without protocol changes

nodes.label: BioML-Bench Benchmark
nodes.rationale: 24 biomedical ML tasks across imaging, drug discovery, protein engineering, and single-cell omics domains

nodes.label: GPT Nanochat Training Optimization Task
nodes.rationale: 300s wall-clock training budget on 87M-parameter decoder-only transformer; metric is validation bits-per-byte

nodes.rationale: Single-agent LLM loop for automated research; used as non-multi-agent reference baseline

nodes.label: Ablation: No Self-Organization
nodes.rationale: Teams fixed at boot with no mid-run reformation; reaches 0.9833 vs full system 0.9777 on GPT nanochat

nodes.label: Ablation: No Cross-Agent Communication
nodes.rationale: Only proposal/result posts allowed; reaches 0.9814 vs full system 0.9777; requires 1.85x more experiments

nodes.label: Ablation: No Analyst Role
nodes.rationale: Only experiment agents; reaches 0.9817 vs full system 0.9777; experiment agents self-organize cross-team probes

nodes.label: Ablation: Independent Agents
nodes.rationale: No cross-agent coordination or shared artifacts; best-of-6 reaches 0.9833 vs full system 0.9777; agents rediscover same wins

nodes.label: Team Size Sensitivity Analysis
nodes.rationale: Crew sizes n=2,4,9,14 show task-dependent sensitivity; n=9 default achieves best quality on TDC-hERG; larger crews finish faster under parallel execution

nodes.label: Run-to-Run Stability Analysis
nodes.rationale: Three independent cold-start runs converge to 0.9777-0.9795 region; mean 0.9784 with SD 0.0010; select different intermediate directions but reach same productive surface

nodes.label: Model Card Output Document
nodes.rationale: Structured document recording model details, training procedure, evaluation, and compute infrastructure

nodes.label: Research Insights Document
nodes.rationale: Reasoning trajectory recording which directions tried, accepted, rejected, and mechanisms for each

nodes.label: Champion Pollution Problem
nodes.rationale: Erroneous promotion of noisy improvements corrupts baseline for all downstream comparisons; prevented by noise-aware gate

nodes.label: Dead-End Registry
nodes.rationale: Shared artifact tracking rejected parameter ranges to prevent duplicate exploration

nodes.label: Forum-Based Coordination
nodes.rationale: Agents post research directions, hypotheses, critiques, and votes; enables self-organization and cross-team awareness

nodes.label: Throughput Optimization Mechanism
nodes.rationale: More optimizer steps within fixed wall-clock budget; dominant effect in GPT nanochat (−0.0090 val_bpb from batch halving)

nodes.label: Capacity Optimization Mechanism
nodes.rationale: More parameters per token with accompanying LR-scale corrections; gated by learning rate accuracy

nodes.label: Optimizer Quality Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Better gradient signal per step via Newton-Schulz iterations, normalization margins, attention patterns

nodes.label: Muon Optimizer (Polar-Express Variant)
nodes.rationale: Hybrid optimizer for 2D matrix parameters with per-group learning rates; 1.02x normalization margin found unnecessary

nodes.label: Short Attention Window Pattern
nodes.rationale: SSSL pattern with ratio 1/8 preserves local/long-range attention balance; pure short (SSSS) and shifted (SSLL) patterns regress

nodes.label: BioML-Bench Biomedical Imaging Domain
nodes.rationale: 4 imaging tasks: histopathologic cancer, pulmonary fibrosis, brain tumor, GI tract; AUTOSCIENTISTS achieves 45.75% leaderboard percentile

nodes.label: BioML-Bench Drug Discovery Domain
nodes.rationale: 9 drug discovery tasks from TDC and Polaris; AUTOSCIENTISTS achieves 64.52% leaderboard percentile, 55.6% above median

nodes.label: BioML-Bench Protein Engineering Domain
nodes.rationale: 6 ProteinGym DMS tasks; AUTOSCIENTISTS achieves 96.97% leaderboard percentile, tied with Autoresearch

nodes.label: BioML-Bench Single Cell Omics Domain
nodes.rationale: 5 single-cell omics tasks; AUTOSCIENTISTS achieves 88.00% leaderboard percentile, 100% above median

nodes.label: TDC hERG Potassium Channel Task
nodes.rationale: Binary classification of hERG inhibition; AUTOSCIENTISTS achieves 0.867 AUROC at n=9 (default crew)

nodes.label: ProteinGym SPIKE-SARS2 Task
nodes.rationale: Protein fitness prediction; AUTOSCIENTISTS achieves 0.874 Spearman ρ at n=2 (best crew size for this task)

nodes.label: Impact Statement
nodes.rationale: AUTOSCIENTISTS may accelerate ML/AI for Science; risks include over-trusting models, overfitting to benchmarks, amplifying erroneous hypotheses

nodes.label: Reproducibility Statement
nodes.rationale: Source code released at GitHub; uses publicly available data; agents work with no human intervention for specified wall-clock time
